tools.name: list_units_and_topics
tools.title: List units and topics
tools.description: List every AP Calculus AB/BC unit in the course, with its exam weighting and the topics inside it. Topic slugs returned here are the values other tools accept.

tools.name: get_practice_questions
tools.title: Get practice questions
tools.description: Draw multiple-choice practice questions the signed-in student has never answered before, on their saved AB/BC track. Optionally scope to a unit or topic slug. Answers are not included; submit one with submit_answer to see the result.

limit.description: How many questions to return, 1-10. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: submit_answer
tools.title: Submit an answer
tools.description: Record the student's answer to a practice question from get_practice_questions and return whether it was correct, the correct choice, and a worked explanation. The question will never be served to them again.

selected_label.description: The chosen choice label: A, B, C, or D.

tools.name: get_performance
tools.title: Get performance breakdown
tools.description: Summarize the signed-in student's practice performance: overall accuracy, per-unit accuracy with mastery status, per-topic accuracy, and units they have not touched. Contains no AP score prediction.

tools.name: list_mistakes
tools.title: List mistakes
tools.description: List entries from the shared Common Mistakes database and, when include_mine is true, the student's own saved mistakes. Optionally filter the shared list by category.

category.description: Filter shared mistakes by category, e.g. Algebra or Units.

include_mine.description: Also return the student's own saved mistakes. Defaults to true.

tools.name: save_mistake
tools.title: Save a mistake
tools.description: Save a mistake to the signed-in student's personal mistakes list. Write in the second person, exam-focused, with all mathematics in inline LaTeX ($...$).

category.description: One or two words, e.g. Algebra, Calculator, Units, Justification, Series.

example.description: A short concrete instance with the correct version.
